title: Monomial under sign changes
statement: Let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, let $y\in\{\pm1\}^r$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, and choose a set of coordinates to negate, specified by a map $\sigma:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The monomial indexed by $S$ after these sign changes equals the original monomial multiplied by $\prod_{i\in S}(-1)$ over the coordinates for which $\sigma(i)=\mathrm{true}$, with factor $1$ for the other coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $r$ coordinates
$S$ is a subset of the $r$ coordinates
$y$ is a sign vector of length $r$
